description.value:
You've learned to align your senses with nature itself. After spending at least 1 minute meditating in a natural setting, you gain the following for the next hour:

  • Natural difficult terrain no longer slows you.
  • You can understand plants within 30 feet, which may telepathically share simple thoughts or memories from the past day.
  • You can direct plants within 30 feet to create difficult terrain or perform other GM-approved tasks, with no action required.

You must complete a short or long rest before you can use this feature again.
